title: Lesson
description: One file under content/lessons/<id>.json. Mirrors the Lesson typedef in app/js/content/types.js. tools/lint-content.js checks this shape by hand (lint rule schema) and adds the corpus rules alphabet, duplicate, reference, pending-practised, register, personal, lesson-count, consolidation, standalone, examples and helper-missing.

id.description: The file is named <id>.json and every id inside the lesson starts with <id>-.

unit.description: Must exist in units.json, and that unit must list this lesson.

order.description: Position within the unit, from 1: the lesson's place in the unit's list (lint rule lesson-count).

role.description: A theme lesson brings new items and rule cards. The consolidation lesson comes last in its unit, introduces no rule card, and its production and dialogue new_items may practise items of the unit's earlier lessons (lint rules consolidation and standalone).

rules.description: Rule cards introduced in this lesson. Each must exist under content/rules/.

slText.description: Slovenian text: the 25 letters of the Slovenian alphabet, digits, spaces and the punctuation .,;:!?'"()- (lint rule alphabet).

promptText.description: Slovenian text with exactly one blank, a run of one or more underscores that may attach to a stem ("Midva ___ lačna.", "Pijem kav_"). The underscore is allowed nowhere else (lint rule alphabet).

enText.description: English copy in generic framing: never a named person or relationship (lint rule personal).

Verification.description: Only items with status accepted are practised; the linter fails a strict build that would practise anything else (lint rule pending-practised).

review1.description: Verdict of the first blind review, null until reviewed.

review2.description: Verdict of the second blind review, null until reviewed.

native.description: What the native speaker said, null until asked.

notes.description: Internal notes, not shown in the app.

fillers.description: Ids of the items that fill this slot.

Item.description: A scheduled item: a chunk, a word, or an inflected form practised on its own. No two items in the corpus share sl and type (lint rule duplicate).

sl_colloquial.description: Colloquial form that is heard but not written.

register.description: recognition items are never asked for in production or structured exercises (lint rule register).

forms.description: Inflected forms by label (case, number), so slot production can grade them.

examples.description: One or two example sentences of at most eight words each (lint rule examples).

helper.description: Cognate, false friend or one-line mnemonic. The linter warns when a cognate has none (lint rule helper-missing).

rules.description: Ids of the rules the item exercises.

freq_rank.description: Rank in the spoken frequency list.

audio.description: Audio ids for the headword and the examples.

StructuredExercise.description: Choose the form or ending in context. Practises a rule, not an item.

ProductionExercise.description: Typed production from English to Slovenian, recorded as a recall of item.

en.description: The instruction shown to the learner.

item.description: The item practised: an item of this lesson, or in a consolidation lesson of this unit up to this lesson (lint rule standalone); it must be accepted for a strict build.

filler.description: The slot filler used, for slot substitutions.

speaker.description: you is the learner; the other speakers are the roles in the scene.

sl.description: At most 60 characters and 10 words, so the line can be typed (lint rule standalone).

accept.description: Other answers that count as correct.

new_items.description: Ids of the items this line practises, under the same rule as a production item (lint rule standalone).

setting_en.description: The scene in English, in generic framing.

cast.description: The recorded voice of each speaker other than the learner.
